input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-06' AND DATE '2026-04-12' THEN 'week_before' WHEN decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-13' AND DATE '2026-04-19' THEN 'incident_week' END AS period, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-06' AND DATE '2026-04-19' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-06' AND DATE '2026-04-12' THEN 'week_before' WHEN decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-13' AND DATE '2026-04-19' THEN 'incident_week' END AS period, reject_reason, SUM(n_rejections) AS rejections FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE 1=0 GROUP BY 1,2
